setup: ARAG chatbot (RAG + GPT-4o) explaining offline greenhouse MPC trajectories to growers
C1_note: Keyword/template non-LLM baseline, deliberately simple strawman (p.6-7); no control comparator
C2_note: Text metrics only: ROUGE-L, BERTScore, Relevance (p.9)
C3_note: No disturbance/fault/mismatch scenarios tested; offline simulated MPC data (p.3)
C4_note: 100 responses with Wilcoxon and HL CIs (p.9); GPT-4o, temp 0.3, prompt templates Figs 4-5 (p.4, p.8-9); no repeat runs
C5_note: Relevance is a mean similarity-type score; no correct/incorrect rate of explanations (p.9)
C6_note: No safeguards; output to human only; feedback only reweights chunks (p.5-6)
llm_latency: GPT-4o 2.17 s (Table 2, p.4); ARAG 21.1 s per query vs baseline 8.4 s (Fig. 8, p.10)
loop_timing: On-demand queries; MPC data at 5-min intervals (p.3)
key_result: ARAG beat keyword/template baseline on 100 responses: BERTScore 0.68 to 0.79 (+12.1%), Relevance 0.41 to 0.57 (+38.3%), p<0.001 (p.9)
limitation: Correlation analysis ignores time-lagged effects; constrained research dataset, needs adaptation for real operations (p.15-16)
